fragments.NativeMatingMaterial:
fragment NativeMatingMaterial on farm_view_task_mating_material {
  id
  task_id
  boar_id
  semen_id
  semen_breeder_type
  semen_collect_at
  semen_count
  boar {
    id
    farm_id
    ear_tag
    ear_notch
  }
}

operations.NativeHealthReferenceCatalog:
query NativeHealthReferenceCatalog {

    id
    name_cn
    name_en
    abbr_cn
    abbr_en
    category_cn
    category_en
    description_cn
    description_en
  }
  farm_view_symptom {
    id
    name_cn
    name_en
    part_cn
    part_en
    description_cn
    description_en
  }
}
operations.NativeTherapyRows:
query NativeTherapyRows($farmId: String!, $filter: farm_view_prescription_therapy_bool_exp!, $order: [farm_view_prescription_therapy_order_by!]!, $offset: Int!, $limit: Int!) {
  rows: farm_view_prescription_therapy(
    where: {_and: [{farm_id: {_eq: $farmId}}, $filter]}
    order_by: $order
    offset: $offset
    limit: $limit
  ) {
    id
    farm_id
    prescription_id
    created_at
    dosage
    interval
    medication_id
    medication_catalog_id
    operator_id
    remark
    start_date
    status
    times
    treatment_id
    unit
    medication {
      id
      farm_id
      name_cn
      name_en
    }
    medication_catalog {
      id
      farm_id
      medication_id
      name_cn
      name_en
      form_cn
      form_en
    }
    treatment {
      id
      name_cn
      name_en
      detail_cn
      detail_en
    }
    prescription {
      id
      farm_id
      created_at
      operator_id
      symptoms
      diseases
      remark
      status
      operator {
        display_name
        avatar_url
      }
      therapies_aggregate {
        aggregate {
          count
        }
      }
    }
    tasks(order_by: [{task_id: asc}, {target_id: asc}, {times: asc}]) {
      farm_id
      prescription_id
      therapy_id
      task_id
      target_id
      times
      status
      scheduled_at
      executed_at
      executed_by
      operator_id
      remark
      pig {
        id
        farm_id
        breeder_code
        ear_notch
        ear_tag
        lifecycle_status
        location_code
        origin
        sex
        breed_type
        birthday
        teat_count
        role
        current_batch_id
        location {
          farm_id
          pen_location
          row_location
          section_location
          unit_location
          zone_location
          pen_number
          zone {
            name_cn
            name_en
          }
          section {
            name_cn
            name_en
          }
          unit {
            name_cn
            name_en
          }
          row {
            code
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
operations.NativeTransferTask:
query NativeTransferTask($id: String!) {
  farm_view_transfer_task_by_pk(transfer_id: $id) {
    transfer_id
    farm_id
    batch_id
    transfer_type
    status
    planned_transfer_time
    actual_start_time
    completed_at
    created_at
    modified_at
    remark
    operator_id
    batch {
      farm_id
      sn
    }
    transfer_in_unit {
      farm_id
      transfer_id
      unit_code
      transfer_in_count
      last_operation_time
      operator_id
    }
    transfer_out_unit {
      farm_id
      transfer_id
      unit_code
      transfer_out_count
      transfer_total_count
      last_operation_time
      operator_id
    }
    items {
      farm_id
      transfer_id
      pig_id
      batch_id
      status
      source_location_code
      destination_location_code
      actual_transfer_time
      failure_reason
      remark
      created_at
      modified_at
      operator_id
      pig {
        id
        farm_id
        ear_tag
        ear_notch
        location_code
        role
        lifecycle_status
      }
    }
  }
}

operations.NativeUnitInspections:

operations.NativeVaccinationTasks:
query NativeVaccinationTasks($farmId: String!, $filter: farm_view_vaccination_task_bool_exp!, $order: [farm_view_vaccination_task_order_by!]!, $offset: Int!, $limit: Int!) {
  rows: farm_view_vaccination_task(
    where: {_and: [{farm_id: {_eq: $farmId}}, $filter]}
    order_by: $order
    offset: $offset
    limit: $limit
  ) {
    id
    farm_id
    vaccine_id
    brand_id
    status
    scheduled_at
    modified_at
    created_at
    completed_at
    executed_at
    executed_by
    operator_id
    route
    interval_value
    interval_unit
    dose_unit
    dose_count
    dose
    completed_target_dose_count
    exempted_target_count
    settled_target_count
    target_count
    task_type
    plan_id
    related_task_id
    effect_review
    is_deleted
    deleted_at
    vaccine {
      id
      farm_id
      name_cn
      name_en
      status
    }
    brand {
      id
      farm_id
      vaccine_id
      brand_name_cn
      brand_name_en
      dosage_form
      status
    }
    targets(order_by: [{target_id: asc}, {dose_index: asc}]) {
      farm_id
      task_id
      target_id
      vaccine_id
      brand_id
      dose_index
      status
      scheduled_at
      executed_at
      executed_by
      operator_id
      vaccination_exemption {
        farm_id
        pig_id
        exemption_hit
        rule_codes
        reasons
        evaluated_at
        effective_until
        modified_at
        operator_id
      }
      pig {
        id
        farm_id
        ear_tag
        ear_notch
        birthday
        breed_type
        role
        lifecycle_status
        location_code
        current_batch_id
        current_batch {
          id
          farm_id
          sn
        }
        location {
          farm_id
          pen_location
          row_location
          section_location
          unit_location
          zone_location
          pen_number
          zone {
            code
            name_cn
            name_en
          }
          section {
            code
            name_cn
            name_en
          }
          unit {
            code
            name_cn
            name_en
          }
          row {
            code
          }
        }
      }
    }
    targets_aggregate {
      aggregate {
        count
      }
    }
  }
}
